name: Monotonic Yang Dimension of Parity Functions
details: The upper bound is hereditary over every subclass, not merely over linear or affine subclasses. It holds in every coefficient characteristic.
proof: As in Section \ref{val:yang_dimension_parity_functions}, this is a binary linear class of dimension 2n. Proposition \ref{prop:affine-class-yang} bounds Yang dimension on each arbitrary subclass by 2n, through the affine-span closure of every version-space ambiguity complex. The whole class has Yang dimension 2n, so the maximum over subclasses is exactly 2n.
